title: Days of the Week
label: ch:ka-days-of-the-week
canDo: I can name any day of the week in Kannada, including the Sunday that uses a different sun-name from Hindi's.

payoff.summary: Run Somavāra through Śanivāra, then name Sunday ಭಾನುವಾರ and say why it is Bhānu here where Hindi says Ravi.
payoff.note: Below the 0.5 floor by sequence, not by omission: KA-C10-vaara (380) is the chapter's only spoken lesson and assesses its own atom. The other two, KA-SCRIPT-RECOG-119 (ೋ, KA-S119-vowel-sign-oo, 385) and KA-SCRIPT-RECOG-141 (೨, KA-S141-digit-two, 387), are taught by script-delivery lessons sequenced after it, so the payoff cannot honestly assess them and neither script lesson is a fitting payoff for the days of the week.
